1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.CutTreeWedgeMoves
2 
3 /-! Finite iteration of the proved expanding-region operation. Coordinates
4 may change at every step; the conclusion compares all kites in one plane.
5 This does not construct the cut-surface quotient or its junction data. -/
6 
7 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge
8 
9 open Set
10 
11 /-- The three geometric facts needed for one step, with its coordinate change. -/
12 structure RegionStep (before after kite : Set Plane) where
13   enlarged : Set Plane
14   motion : Plane ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] Plane
15   contains : before ⊆ enlarged
16   avoids : Disjoint enlarged (interior kite)
17   updated : motion '' (enlarged ∪ kite) = after
18 
19 namespace RegionStep
20 
21 variable {before after kite : Set Plane} (step : RegionStep before after kite)
22 
23 theorem carries_before : step.motion '' before ⊆ after := by
24   exact (image_mono (step.contains.trans subset_union_left)).trans step.updated.subset
25 
26 theorem carries_kite : step.motion '' kite ⊆ after := by
27   exact (image_mono subset_union_right).trans step.updated.subset
28 
29 include step in
30 theorem before_avoids : Disjoint before (interior kite) :=
31   step.avoids.mono step.contains Subset.rfl
32 
33 end RegionStep
34 
35 /-- Map each successive local coordinate plane back to the first one. -/
36 noncomputable def chainFrame (moves : ℕ → Plane ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] Plane) : ℕ → Plane ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] Plane
37   | 0 => AffineIsometryEquiv.refl ℝ Plane
38   | n + 1 => (moves n).symm.trans (chainFrame moves n)
39 
40 theorem chainFrame_step (moves : ℕ → Plane ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] Plane) (n : ℕ) (x : Plane) :
41     chainFrame moves (n + 1) (moves n x) = chainFrame moves n x := by
42   change chainFrame moves n ((moves n).symm (moves n x)) = chainFrame moves n x
43   rw [(moves n).symm_apply_apply]
44 
45 /-- A finite chain of actual steps separates every earlier closed kite
46 from the ordinary interior of every later kite in one common plane. -/
47 theorem finite_chain_separation (n : ℕ) (regions kites : ℕ → Set Plane)
48     (steps : ∀ i : Fin n, RegionStep (regions i) (regions (i + 1)) (kites i)) :
49     ∃ frames : ℕ → Plane ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] Plane,
50       frames 0 = AffineIsometryEquiv.refl ℝ Plane ∧
51       (∀ i : Fin n, ∀ x, frames (i + 1) ((steps i).motion x) = frames i x) ∧
52       (∀ i j : ℕ, i < j → j < n →
53         Disjoint (frames i '' kites i) (interior (frames j '' kites j))) ∧
54       (∀ j : ℕ, j < n → Disjoint (regions 0) (interior (frames j '' kites j))) ∧
55       (∀ i j : ℕ, i ≤ j → j ≤ n → frames i '' regions i ⊆ frames j '' regions j) := by
56   classical
57   let moves (i : ℕ) : Plane ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] Plane :=
58     if small : i < n then (steps ⟨i, small⟩).motion else AffineIsometryEquiv.refl ℝ Plane
59   let frames := chainFrame moves
60   have changes (i : Fin n) (x : Plane) :
61       frames (i + 1) ((steps i).motion x) = frames i x := by
62     have move_eq : moves i = (steps i).motion := dif_pos i.isLt
63     rw [← move_eq]
64     exact chainFrame_step moves i x
65   let R (i : ℕ) := frames i '' regions i
66   let K (i : ℕ) := frames i '' kites i
67   have grows (i : ℕ) (small : i < n) : R i ⊆ R (i + 1) := by
68     rintro _ ⟨x, member, rfl⟩
69     let s := steps ⟨i, small⟩
70     exact ⟨s.motion x, s.carries_before ⟨x, member, rfl⟩, changes ⟨i, small⟩ x⟩
71   have added (i : ℕ) (small : i < n) : K i ⊆ R (i + 1) := by
72     rintro _ ⟨x, member, rfl⟩
73     let s := steps ⟨i, small⟩
74     exact ⟨s.motion x, s.carries_kite ⟨x, member, rfl⟩, changes ⟨i, small⟩ x⟩
75   have avoids (i : ℕ) (small : i < n) : Disjoint (R i) (interior (K i)) := by
76     have disjoint := disjoint_image_of_injective (frames i).injective (steps ⟨i, small⟩).before_avoids
77     have image_interior : frames i '' interior (kites i) = interior (frames i '' kites i) :=
78       (frames i).toHomeomorph.image_interior _
79     rw [image_interior] at disjoint
80     exact disjoint
81   have monotone (i j : ℕ) (order : i ≤ j) (bound : j ≤ n) : R i ⊆ R j := by
82     induction j, order using Nat.le_induction with
83     | base => exact Subset.rfl
84     | succ j order previous =>
85       exact (previous (by omega)).trans (grows j (by omega))
86   refine ⟨frames, rfl, changes, ?_, ?_, monotone⟩
87   · intro i j before small
88     exact (avoids j small).mono ((added i (by omega)).trans
89       (monotone (i + 1) j before (by omega))) Subset.rfl
90   · intro j small
91     have start : R 0 = regions 0 := by simp only [R, frames, chainFrame, AffineIsometryEquiv.coe_refl, image_id]
92     rw [← start]
93     exact (avoids j small).mono (monotone 0 j (by omega) (by omega)) Subset.rfl
94 
95 /-- Enclose the first kite, carry it through finitely many moves, and
96 exclude a final kite without requiring a chart beyond that last edge. -/
97 theorem finite_chain_endpoint_separation (n : ℕ) (regions kites : ℕ → Set Plane)
98     (steps : ∀ i : Fin n, RegionStep (regions i) (regions (i + 1)) (kites i))
99     (first last : Set Plane) (initial : first ⊆ regions 0)
100     (terminal : Disjoint (regions n) (interior last)) :
101     ∃ frames : ℕ → Plane ≃ᵃⁱ[ℝ] Plane,
102       frames 0 = AffineIsometryEquiv.refl ℝ Plane ∧
103       (∀ i : Fin n, ∀ x, frames (i + 1) ((steps i).motion x) = frames i x) ∧
104       Disjoint first (interior (frames n '' last)) := by
105   obtain ⟨frames, start, compatible, _, _, grows⟩ := finite_chain_separation n regions kites steps
106   have first_inside : first ⊆ frames n '' regions n := by
107     intro x member
108     apply grows 0 n (by omega) le_rfl
109     refine ⟨x, initial member, ?_⟩
110     rw [start]
111     rfl
112   have final_avoids := disjoint_image_of_injective (frames n).injective terminal
113   have final_interior : frames n '' interior last = interior (frames n '' last) :=
114     (frames n).toHomeomorph.image_interior _
115   rw [final_interior] at final_avoids
116   exact ⟨frames, start, compatible, final_avoids.mono first_inside Subset.rfl⟩
117 
118 end SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge

120 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.JunctionFan.WedgeMove
121 
122 open Wedge
123 
124 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {a : frontier P.body} {T : P.CutLocusTree a}
125     {u : T.vertices} {fan : JunctionFan T u}
126     {incoming outgoing : circularGapMidpoints fan.order.angles fan.order.first fan.order.last}
127     {next_chart : P.CutVoronoiChart a (T.vertexTarget (fan.order.neighbors outgoing).val)} {φ : ℝ}
128     {next : IncidentTriangles T (fan.order.neighbors outgoing).property.symm next_chart φ} {ω : ℝ}
129 
130 /-- The constructed geometric move supplies every hypothesis of finite region iteration. -/
131 def toRegionStep (move : fan.WedgeMove incoming outgoing next ω) :
132     RegionStep ((fan.triangles incoming).incomingWedge ω)
133       (next.incomingWedge (ω + (fan.triangles outgoing).model.sourceAngle))
134       (fan.triangles outgoing).developedKite :=
135   ⟨move.enlarged, move.motion, move.contains, move.avoids, move.updated⟩
136 
137 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.JunctionFan.WedgeMove
